name: Dulio
source:
Duilio is the first boy you started looking after: since being taken in by Borujano. He is skilled at fighting with threads and much is expected of him in the future. He has the calmness of an adult and puts on the face of an innocent child. Along with these two sides he has possessive yandere traits. He tends to take a philosophical view on things and is somehow cold. His parents ran a tailor business while they actually worked as assassins in the background. It’s due to playing with string lying around since he was little that he unknowingly became skilled at using it as a weapon.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiakaigai]Google Play[/url]]
